name: sendMessage
shortDescription: Sends a secure and auditable message between a patient and a doctor, handling encryption and storing content.
description:
Overview

Facilitates secure, encrypted, and auditable communication between patients and their assigned doctors, storing message content and triggering external notifications.

Intended use

Called by the messaging UI when a patient or doctor sends a new message. The UI provides parameters such as senderId, receiverId, conversationId, content, and isEncrypted.

Logic

  1. Validate that params.senderId and params.receiverId correspond to valid Patient and Doctor entities respectively.
  2. Encrypt the params.content if params.isEncrypted is true.
  3. Create a new Message record using ctx.data.create with senderId, receiverId, conversationId, current timestamp, encrypted content, and isEncrypted status.
  4. Audit-log the message sending using ctx.audit.log, including sender, receiver, and conversation ID.
  5. Trigger the sendMessageWebhook function to send external notifications about the new message.
  6. Return the created Message record.

Entities

  • Message
  • Patient
  • Doctor

External Services

  • Webhook
